tldr: Evening batch, Aug 15: The price war escalates — OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna ~80% and Anthropic priced Opus 5 at half of Fable 5 while DeepSeek and Z.ai overtook both in OpenRouter token usage. Security stories dominate: encrypted chain-of-thought blocks from all major labs get decoded (182 credentials exposed), the first US court sanctions a prompt-injection attempt in filings, and GPT-5.6-Cyber finds two real Chrome V8 zero-days. Anthropic is in talks to buy Decart AI for ~$6B ahead of its reported mega IPO, IBM launches an OpenAI Practice, HF's State of Open Models report shows small models still dominate real usage, and Qwen3.8 open weights go live Day-0 across the serving stack.

articles.title: AI Books Flood Amazon: 20% of Self-Published Catalog, 12% of Sales
articles.summary: Study of 14,419 titles: AI books are 20% of Amazon's self-published catalog but only 12% of sales; human authors lost ground in 7 of 8 genres.

articles.title: First US Court Sanctions Prompt-Injection Attempt in Legal Filings
articles.summary: Connecticut plaintiff hid white-on-white AI instructions in filings; judge banned e-filing, ordered paper copies — first US case of its kind.

articles.title: Encrypted Reasoning Blocks Decoded: 182 Credentials Exposed
articles.summary: Chain-of-thought 'encryption' cracked: 315K reasoning blocks decoded from public repos across OpenAI/Anthropic/Google, exposing 367 PII records and 182 credentials.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Slash Prices as Chinese Models Take Token Crown
articles.summary: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna ~80% and Anthropic priced Opus 5 at half of Fable 5, as DeepSeek and Z.ai overtook them in OpenRouter token usage.

articles.title: GPT-5.6-Cyber Found Two Real Chrome V8 Zero-Days
articles.summary: OpenAI's Daybreak Red model found two previously unknown Chrome V8 bugs; Google patched them as CVE-2026-15903.

articles.title: HF State of Open Models: Small Models Still Dominate Real Usage
articles.summary: HF: frontier models grow larger but small models dominate real usage; Qwen leads local inference, agents are a growing Hub force.

articles.title: Anthropic in Talks to Buy Decart AI for ~$6B
articles.summary: Anthropic in talks to buy Nvidia-backed Decart AI for ~$6B — its largest known deal, adding chip-efficiency tech to inference ahead of a reported mega IPO.

articles.title: IBM Launches OpenAI Practice, Embeds GPT-5.6 Into Consulting
articles.summary: IBM embeds GPT-5.6, Codex and ChatGPT Work into Consulting Advantage and launches a dedicated OpenAI Practice with thousands of certified consultants.

articles.title: Hermes Agent v0.20.1 Rolls Up ~656 Merged PRs
articles.summary: Patch release closes ~481 issues across 1,444 commits since v0.20.0 — a stabilization milestone ahead of the v0.21.0 feature release.

articles.title: Qwen3.8 Open Weights Live Day-0 Across the Serving Stack
articles.summary: 2.4T-A95B live on Together AI (1M context) and DeepInfra; 27B on vLLM single-GPU; Max on SiliconFlow — the fastest open-weight distribution play yet.
